title: President Trump designates the Oval Office as a national monument
excerpt: The proclamation includes the Oval Office, the Outer Oval Office, and the Cabinet Room under the Antiquities Act.
bodyHtml:
On November 5, 2026, President Donald J. Trump signed a Proclamation establishing the Oval Office as a National Monument. The designation, made under the Antiquities Act, includes the Oval Office, the Outer Oval Office, and the Cabinet Room.

The Proclamation directs the Secretary of the Interior to develop and implement a management plan with relevant executive departments, agencies, and offices. This plan is to prioritize the preservation of the Oval Office, to document, review, and consider alternatives before substantially altering or demolishing the Oval Office, and to ensure that any proposed changes to its historic character are consistent with the Oval Office’s national significance.

The Proclamation also directs the Secretary of the Interior to coordinate with the Committee for the Preservation of the White House and other appropriate advisory bodies.
